top_signals.title: US Stocks Rebound Ahead of Earnings; Zelenskyy Says Trump Pushing Kyiv to Yield
top_signals.summary: US equity future rise as tech stocks look set to snap a 8-session losing streak. President Zelenskyy accuses President Trump of trying to push Ukraine to give in to Russia. Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to "every kid in America" next year. Ella Gude of BNY joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the global AI trade and valuations. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: APC Expands in Middle East, Europe
top_signals.summary: Advanced Polymer Coatings (APC) expanded its international maritime sales team with two appointments.James Kennedy has been appointed to lead sales across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, including Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait and Oman.
